The '''Bent Lekku cantina''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Army of Life]] member [[Del Binjitt]] hired a group of agents to transport some [[clodhopper]]s to the planet [[Stend IV]] and he stated that once the agents had completed their assignment, he would meet them in the Bent Lekku cantina to give them their payment.
